definitions.explanation: Having more than enough money and material possessions to live comfortably. A neutral, non-flashy way to describe someone who is financially comfortable.

examples.japanese: {裕福|ゆうふく}な⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: She grew up in a wealthy family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裕福|ゆうふく}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{幸|しあわ}せな⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: He isn't wealthy, but he leads a happy life.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{比較的|ひかくてき}→比較的：06172_hikakuteki⟧{裕福|ゆうふく}な⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{水準|すいじゅん}→水準：03357_suijun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This area has many relatively affluent households, and the standard of education is also high.

notes:
USAGE:
A neutral, respectful way to describe wealth. Less flashy than ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧ (rich person) and more dignified than リッチ (rich). Often used to describe families and backgrounds rather than individuals.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裕福|ゆうふく}: wealthy, well-off (dignified, moderate tone)
- ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧: rich person (direct, casual)
- {富裕|ふゆう}: affluent (formal, often in statistics)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裕福|ゆうふく}な⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧: wealthy family
- {裕福|ゆうふく}な⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: affluent lifestyle
